content.short: Crabada is the most popular play-to-earn game on Avalanche focused on undersea adventures.
content.description: Launched in November 2021, Crabada is a play-to-earn game on Avalanche where players breed, trade, and battle NFT hermit crabs. It is often described as the next Axie Infinity due to its core focus on collecting and combat among NFT creatures. Crabada is an idle game, so players can earn native tokens and trade NFTs without dedicating extensive time. At its peak, it attracted about 8.5K daily users and accounted for over 64% of on-chain transactions.
